sentences.text:
Author: R. Raghunandan Rao
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Criminal PETITION.No.1999 of 2021
Order:

The petitioners are accused in Crime No.67 of 2021 of Dachepalli Police Station, Guntur District for the offences under Sections 270, 273, 420 r/w 34 of IPC and under Sections 56, 57 (1), 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. The petition filed by the petitioners in Criminal Petition No.1373 of 2021 was quashed by way of an order of this Court dated 08.03.2021.

However, the tobacco products and the vehicle bearing No.TS 07 UJ 3309 seized from the petitioners on 10.02.2021 have not been released to them despite the fact that the criminal case itself has been quashed.

3. The petitioners have now approached this Court by way of this criminal petition for release of the seized tobacco products as well as the vehicle bearing No.TS 07 UJ 3309.
4.
As the criminal case itself has been quashed, the petitioners would be entitled to release of tobacco products.

5. Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is allowed directing the Station House Officer, Dachepalli Police Station, Guntur District concerned to release the tobacco products as well as the vehicle bearing No.TS 07 UJ 3309, seized from the petitioners dated 10.02.2021.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO, J.
30th March, 2021 RJS.
HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO 30th March, 2021 RJS.
